title: Simple Enhancement
description: This mod adds a variety of engaging combat systems, new biomes, unique materials, gear and weapons. It stays true to the original game style, is lightweight and full of fun. Start your adventure now!
body:
# Simple Enhancement

**A lightweight Minecraft 1.21.1 NeoForge mod that expands combat with new enchantments, gear, and an upgrade system.**

---

## ✨ Enchantments (13)

| Enchantment        | Max Level | Description                                        |
|--------------------|-----------|----------------------------------------------------|
| Reach Strike       | III       | Extends melee attack range                         |
| Swift Strike       | III       | Increases attack speed                             |
| Heavy Strike       | III       | Adds bonus damage per hit                          |
| Guard Strike       | III       | Grants damage resistance on kill                   |
| Weaken Strike      | III       | Inflicts Weakness on struck enemies                |
| All-In Strike      | I         | Massive damage at the cost of durability           |
| Ender Pulse        | III       | Teleports the attacker to the target               |
| Delay Slash        | I         | Damage dealt after a short delay                   |
| Sacrificial Slash  | III       | Bonus damage at the cost of your own health        |
| Hunger Slash       | III       | Restores hunger on kill                            |
| Wave Swift         | I         | Increased damage while in water                    |
| Life Absorb        | III       | Steals health from enemies                         |
| Mob Friend         | I         | Chance to pacify hostile mobs                      |

---

## ⚔️ Gear & Items

- **Reinforced Netherite Set** — A full tier of armor and tools crafted from netherite diamond alloy  
- **Upgrade Orb (Lv1–6)** — Upgrade your sword's base stats via an anvil  
- **Reflective Shield** — Blocks and reflects incoming projectiles  
- **Confusion Charge** — Throwable projectile that disorients enemies  
- **Mutagen** — Grants temporary combat mutations  
- **Smithing Templates** — Basic and advanced templates for gear progression  

---

## 🧭 World Loot

Enchanted books and upgrade orbs can be found in structure chests across all vanilla tiers — from dungeons and shipwrecks to nether fortresses and end cities.
